services.name: The Wizard Realm
services.desc: Immerse yourself in a wizarding-school escape experience where you pose as a student to investigate strange readings and solve puzzles. 2-6 People · Difficulty Choice 6/10 - 8/10 · 60 minutes

services.name: P.T. Railways: Rebel Run
services.desc: Private one-hour escape-room experience where teams attempt to 'steal' a high-tech train after being hired by a mysterious organization. 3-10 People · Theme: Train Heist · 60 min · Difficulty Choice 6/10 - 8/10

services.name: P.T. Railways: Spectral Rift
services.desc: A one-hour private immersive train-themed puzzle experience with a mysterious letter and teamwork-based challenges. 3-10 People · Theme: Spirit Railroad · 60 minutes · Difficulty Choice 7/10 - 9/10

services.name: Warehouse 13
services.desc: Immersive one-hour escape-room experience where teams investigate a missing-people mystery in Warehouse 13 and gather intel as special agents. 3-10 People · 60 minutes · Theme: Creepy/Scary · Difficulty Choice 6/10 - 8/10

services.name: Jungle 2: The Next Dimension
services.desc: One-hour immersive escape-room experience set in a transformed jungle dimension where teams solve new puzzles to uncover a missing assistant’s fate. 2-8 People · Difficulty: Adjustable · 60 minutes
